_no_dates: Deliberate. The bucket carries no survey years and this file invents none; the annotation records an explicit unknown instead.
_bounds_are_a_hint: Extents are derived from a listing at zoom 9, so a box is snapped to about 78 km and several counties contain any given point. Fine for choosing a default; not a containment test. To know what actually covers a coordinate, ask the bucket for the tile.
